# Every (code, status) pair the api package and the identity layer can write under /api/v1 at
# c8a44f97, one pair a line: CODE STATUS, where * is the status of ANSWER_NOT_KEPT, which answers
# with the status of the first answer it could not keep. TestV1CodesAreTheCodesOfC8a44f97 holds
# apicode's v1 names and statuses to this list, so a v1 code cannot change unseen.
#
# Made once by a throwaway script over c8a44f97's packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api: every
# errorf and writeError whose code and status are a literal or a constant, the code literals
# requireUUIDPath (its kind's <KIND>_ID_INPUT), countExceededError and replyBlockOf are given,
# idRoutes' not-found codes (404), and each body WriteJSON writes with a code member at a literal
# status. The codes a variable carries were added by hand: writeHandlerError's document codes and
# its editLostError body, the keyed layer's ANSWER_NOT_KEPT, and identity.WriteError's three. Left
# out: the router's own codes (routes writes them, on no route of the api package; HOST_MISMATCH
# answers every path in dev sign-in mode, unchanged), and TEST_HOOK_TIMEOUT 504 and
# TEST_HOOK_UNAVAILABLE 503, which only the test hooks' testHookFailure writes.
#
# After them, each pair a later merge on main added, named on its line, added at each forward
# merge as v1-only-routes.txt is. Last, as comments, each pair of c8a44f97 that a later merge on
# main stopped answering, named on its line, taken out of the list at the forward merge that
# brings it.
